name: work.doingwork/shop
title: Field Service Business Platform by Doing Work
description: Headless field service software. Your AI agent runs jobs, schedules, quotes, invoices and payments.

tools.name: me_get
tools.description: The signed-in person. Call me.start for shops, what this connection can do, and the next tasks.

tools.name: me_start
tools.description: Start here. Shops this connection can use, the grant in plain words, counts, and the next tasks for the state of each shop.

tools.name: jobs_create
tools.description: Start a job at a home, found or created from the address: address is an object, not a string, with required line1, locality, postal_code and jurisdiction (line2 is optional; jurisdiction is an ISO 3166-2 code like US-ID, and a US shop also accepts ID, id, or Idaho), for example {"line1":"100 Test St","locality":"Boise","postal_code":"83702","jurisdiction":"US-ID"}.

address.description: address is an object, not a string, with required line1, locality, postal_code and jurisdiction (line2 is optional; jurisdiction is an ISO 3166-2 code like US-ID, and a US shop also accepts ID, id, or Idaho), for example {"line1":"100 Test St","locality":"Boise","postal_code":"83702","jurisdiction":"US-ID"}

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-2 like US-ID. ID, id, and Idaho are accepted for a US shop.

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.description: Jobs of a shop you belong to, newest first. A field worker sees only jobs with a visit they are assigned to. A lead also sees jobs their crew is on. Another shop is refused, including a shop token pointed at a different shop. Optional status filter. Shop roles are owner, office, lead and field.

limit.description: How many jobs to return (default 50). An integer, or a numeric string such as "50".

tools.name: quotes_create
tools.description: Create a quote (AI can draft lines; a person who can send quotes approves agent-drafted lines before the quote is sent). Optional: good, better, best options and optional lines the customer picks when signing.

option_key.description: Put this line only in the option with this key. Leave out for a line shared by every option.

optional.description: The customer can add or leave out this line when signing.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

options.description: Good, better, best: 2 to 5 options the customer chooses one of when signing. Each needs its own lines.

tm.description: Rush or open-ended work: the customer signs the rates, and invoices.createFromTm bills approved time and materials at them. Lines may then be empty.

rate_minor.description: Price per worker per hour or day, in cents

rush_rate_minor.description: Optional higher rate for time the shop marks as rush

hours_per_day.description: Hours that make one day on a day rate. Default 8.

materials_markup_bps.description: Added to what the shop paid for materials, in basis points (2000 is 20%)

cap_minor.description: Optional not-to-exceed amount. Billing stops there until a change order is approved.

notes.description: Written scope of work stored on this version. The customer page and PDF show it.

tax_rate_id.description: Tax rate to charge (taxes.listRates). Leave out to use the shop default rate; null for no tax.

tools.name: quotes_send
tools.description: Lock the quote and get a single-use signing link for the customer (the customer signs on the hosted page; an agent cannot sign or accept a quote). Who may send is shops.sendPermissions: the owner always may, office for any job, a lead for jobs on their crew, and a field worker for jobs assigned to them, until the owner turns that off. Lines an agent drafted are refused until a person who may send quotes sends the quote. An agent token cannot send those lines. A quote imported as history cannot be sent.

email_customer.description: Also email the customer a branded email with their own signing link, from the shop. Default false: you share sign_url yourself.

tools.name: quotes_revise
tools.description: Pass the COMPLETE new line list; any line you omit is removed. Replace an unsigned quote with a new version. Earlier signing links stop working; send it again for a new link.

option_key.description: Put this line only in the option with this key. Leave out for a line shared by every option.

optional.description: The customer can add or leave out this line when signing.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

options.description: Good, better, best: 2 to 5 options the customer chooses one of when signing. Each needs its own lines.

tm.description: New rates. Leave out to keep the rates of the last version; null to make it a fixed price quote.

rate_minor.description: Price per worker per hour or day, in cents

rush_rate_minor.description: Optional higher rate for time the shop marks as rush

hours_per_day.description: Hours that make one day on a day rate. Default 8.

materials_markup_bps.description: Added to what the shop paid for materials, in basis points (2000 is 20%)

cap_minor.description: Optional not-to-exceed amount. Billing stops there until a change order is approved.

notes.description: Written scope of work stored on this version. Leave out to keep the notes of the last version; null to clear.

tax_rate_id.description: Tax rate to charge (taxes.listRates). Leave out to use the shop default rate; null for no tax.

tools.name: quotes_list
tools.description: Customer quotes in one shop, newest first. Filter by job_id, status, or both. Read only. Send shop_id or job_id. A shop you are not a member of is refused, and a job you cannot access is not found.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 50 when you leave it out. An integer, or a numeric string such as "50".

tools.name: invoices_createFromQuote
tools.description: Create an invoice for a signed quote, for the total of the option and optional lines the customer picked. A quote imported as history cannot be invoiced.

deposit_minor.description: Optional deposit asked for on the first send

tools.name: invoices_send
tools.description: Send an invoice (or the next part of it) and get a single-use pay link. Who may send is shops.sendPermissions: the owner always may, office for any job, a lead for jobs on their crew, and a field worker for jobs assigned to them, until the owner turns that off. Lines an agent drafted stay unsent until a person who may send invoices sends them. An agent token cannot send those lines. Earlier pay links stop working. Refused with conflict on a Doing Work deposit invoice whose booking ended (shop cancel or no-show). payments_ready false means the shop has no active payments account yet (after a hand-off, connect one with payments.connectLink); the link shows payment isn't available until it does.

amount_minor.description: Amount to ask for now. Defaults to the deposit on the first send, then the balance.

percent.description: Progress billing: ask for this percent of the invoice total now (capped at the balance). Use instead of amount_minor.

email_customer.description: Also email the customer a branded email with their own pay link, from the shop. Default false: you share pay_url yourself.

tools.name: customers_create
tools.description: Add a customer to a shop, with kind, company, email, phone, billing address, lead source, tags and notes in one call.

tools.name: customers_search
tools.description: Find customers by name, company, email, phone or property address.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 50 when you leave it out. An integer, or a numeric string such as "50".

tools.name: visits_create
tools.description: Book a visit to a job at a time, optionally with the workers going (assignee_ids, a saved crew_id, or both). Overlaps for those workers come back in conflicts.

arrival_window_minutes.description: Arrival window in minutes: the customer is told the worker arrives between starts_at and starts_at plus this. Defaults to the shop's setting (schedule.setRules).

priority.description: normal (default), urgent or emergency. Urgent and emergency visits send visit.priority_set and can use dispatch.suggest.

tools.name: invoices_create
tools.description: Create an invoice without a quote (AI can draft lines; a person who can send invoices approves agent-drafted lines before the invoice is sent). Optional due date, memo and deposit. Send it with invoices.send.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

tax_rate_id.description: Tax rate to charge. Leave out for the shop default rate; null for no tax.

tools.name: invoices_list
tools.description: Invoices in one shop, newest first. Filter by status or by a customer name or invoice id. Read only. A shop you are not a member of is refused. Seeing the amounts needs see_prices, the same as invoices.get.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 50 when you leave it out. An integer, or a numeric string such as "50".

tools.name: notes_add
tools.description: Write a note on any shop record: a job, visit, photo or video, customer, property, equipment, quote, invoice, request, worker, payment, price book item, maintenance plan or the shop (target_kind and target_id; job_id or visit_id alone also work). Any shop member can. Notes are internal to the shop and never shown to the customer. Set audience office to keep it to owner and office (owner or office only); notes on a worker or payment are always office. pinned keeps it at the top (owner or office only). Attach photos or videos already on the job with media_ids. Mention members to notify them; say what you need from them in the note. Write down what the worker tells you about a record here so the next person sees it. Pass channel when the words came from a text, an email, a call, or the visit (typed, email, call, text, visit). It is stored on the note.

target_kind.description: What the note is on. worker is a membership id, payment a charge id, media a photo or video id, shop the shop id. Notes on a worker or a payment are office only.

channel.description: Where the words came from: typed, email, call, text, or visit.

audience.description: team (default): every shop member sees it. office: owner, office and the managing platform only.

media_ids.description: Photos or videos already on the job.

mentions.description: Person ids of shop members to notify (team.list). They get an email unless they turned it off. Office notes can mention only owner and office. Customers are never notified.

agent_name.description: Your agent's name, shown next to the writer, when an agent wrote the note for the worker.

tools.name: ops_search
tools.description: Search all 400+ Doing Work operations (inventory, purchase orders, QuickBooks, payroll, maintenance plans, checklists, phone setup, reports) by keyword. Returns tool names and input schemas to pass to ops_call.

query.description: Keyword or area to search for, e.g. 'purchase order', 'quickbooks', 'timesheet', 'checklist'.

tools.name: ops_call
tools.description: Invoke any Doing Work operation discovered via ops_search (or known by name, e.g. 'po_create' or 'books.export') with its arguments and optional idempotencyKey.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the operation's inputSchema.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key for write operations.
